<!--
Joining SweBIdx or updating your profile? Complete the checklist below.

Other changes? Delete the checklist and describe your changes instead.
-->

## New or updated member

- [ ] I added or updated my member file `_members/<first-name>-<last-name>.md` based on `_members/_template.md`
- [ ] All my affiliations exist in `_organizations/` (I added missing ones based on `_organizations/_template.md`)
- [ ] If I added a photo, it is in `assets/images/members/` and meets the requirements in `_members/_template.md`
- [ ] I consent to the publication of my personal data as described in `_members/_template.md` (GDPR)
